claude_proposed_widenings.name: negate_critical_hit_against_wearer
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive magic-item family exists, but the effect vocabulary has no target-side atom for downgrading an incoming critical hit to a normal hit. `modify_crit_range` is attacker-side and would be dishonest here.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_adamantine_armor.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
